criterion_text: `enter new` and `enter resume` select the exact requested Claude conversation on a named Session; idle/in-process and Shell paths are verified, busy/waiting/foreign/stale targets fail without spawning conflicting transcript writers.

verifiers.summary: the enter Tool contracts are pinned in source; the live verifiers drive the in-process and Shell paths with a real CLI

evidence.value: enter requires an explicit agent_id/session_id, `new` chooses the conversation id itself, `resume` requires an explicit conversation_id and refuses omission/blank, and a foreign Agent target is refused before any input

verifiers.summary: a real Claude CLI 2.1.312 (Claude Code) changed to a new exact conversation via /clear, restored the exact requested id via /resume, refused a foreign Agent target, and refused to redirect a waiting CLI

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: CLI 2.1.312 (resolved 2.1.312 (Claude Code)); enter new launched a verified idle conversation 748ab8db-ec90-4a97-9567-2b0f9ceed7d5 whose first turn (Reply with the single word READY and nothing else.) was readable by the exact id
enter new on the verified idle CLI sent /clear and reported entered; the exact verified id changed from 748ab8db-ec90-4a97-9567-2b0f9ceed7d5 to 91f25993-c378-4657-85d2-dbeb383215ca
enter resume 748ab8db-ec90-4a97-9567-2b0f9ceed7d5 on the verified idle CLI sent /resume and restored exactly that id (entered, verified idle)

enter addressed to a foreign Agent was refused before any input: nession_claude_enter refused: { "error": { "kind": "invalid_argument", "message": "this Claude provider is Agent 'claude-live', not 'foreign-agent'" } }

enter new while the live CLI waited at an AskUserQuestion prompt answered status=refused with the same verified conversation and no second writer: Claude is not verifiably idle; refusing to redirect it or create a concurrent transcript writer

verifiers.summary: a real Claude CLI 2.1.312 (Claude Code) was resumed by exact id through the Session shell, a stale id spawned no writer, and a busy conversation refused a redirect

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: CLI 2.1.312 (resolved 2.1.312 (Claude Code)); after /exit the Session answered process=not_running with the original id still known to the verifier
enter resume with the stale id 50139098-2dce-4e3d-ac66-c9d9c669995a answered pending; no Claude process or invented conversation was left running
the Session shell launched `claude --resume 8f4cffd0-bf79-48df-8c56-d1ba7defecbe` and the typed status verified exactly that id, running and idle (entered)

enter new while the resumed shell-launched Claude was busy answered status=refused with no second transcript writer: Claude is not verifiably idle; refusing to redirect it or create a concurrent transcript writer
